name: keys
description: Local-first pack management for AI agents - backendless CLI for ZEO and ControlPlane integration

scripts.keys:init: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts init
scripts.keys:add: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts add
scripts.keys:list: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts list
scripts.keys:search: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts search
scripts.keys:show: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts show
scripts.keys:export: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts export
scripts.keys:run: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts run
scripts.keys:doctor: cd src && npx tsx cli/keys.ts doctor
scripts.build: npm run keys:build && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.type-check: npm run keys:typecheck && npm run type-check:frontend && npm run type-check:backend
scripts.verify:fast: npm run keys:typecheck && npm run lint && npm run type-check
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:fast && npm run build && npm run test:all
scripts.test:all: npm run keys:test && cd frontend && npm run test && cd ../backend && npm run test
scripts.db:reconcile: echo 'Run migration: backend/supabase/migrations/00000000000000_backend_contract_reconcile.sql in Supabase SQL editor'
scripts.keys:legacy:check: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm --workspace backend run test && npm --workspace frontend run test
scripts.keys:legacy:audit: detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline && npm --workspace backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --workspace frontend audit --audit-level=high
